about.title: Jeune Riche
about.message: For the brand's world and philosophy, discover the JEUNE RICHE manifesto.
about.metaDescription: JEUNE RICHE, a streetwear label born in Côte d'Ivoire. The crowned king-face, name personalisation, and the house manifesto.

manifesto.metaDescription: A crown engraved on a tribal face. The JEUNE RICHE manifesto: the tension between luxury and the street, held by one symbol and a tight palette.
manifesto.section1: An engraved crown on a tribal face.
manifesto.section2Title: The black that affirms, the white that breathes — nothing else.
manifesto.section2Body: No gradients, no studio color mistaken for a brand color. A tight, disciplined palette.
manifesto.imageAlt1: Tribal king-face embroidered on a black JEUNE RICHE t-shirt
manifesto.section3Body: JEUNE RICHE owns the tension between luxury and the street, between the discipline of minimalism and the power of an engraved symbol.
manifesto.section4: A visual language that repeats, engraves, and is worn.
